title: Fix remaining vulnerable sandbox tooling dependencies
scope: Resolve the seven assigned dependency vulnerability records across root and Mockup Sandbox manifests and locks. Preserve already patched root consumers; update compatible sandbox tooling and add regression checks covering both lockfiles and actual consumers. No product behavior or gate changes.
why: Dependency security requires the registered audit, production build/startup and existing runtime regression coverage.
coverage: docs/validation/manifest.json test-heavy includes unit-tests (dependency-tooling-security.test.mjs), dependency-audit, startup smoke, compiler checks and browser coverage.

approval.direction: Fix the seven specified dependency vulnerability records
approval.applicability: Compatible dependency updates and recurrence guards only

assertions.check: Both committed lockfiles and actual installed consumers reject every listed affected version and require compatible patched releases.
Existing tooling behavior fixtures, production build/startup and browser workload remain passing after dependency resolution changes.

regression.rationale: Repairs vulnerable development toolchain dependencies while preserving supported tooling consumers.
regression.covers: R1 vulnerable dependencies recurring in root or sandbox; R2 patched tooling breaking existing compilation or runtime
regression.assertion: Require patched stable versions in each lockfile and consumer resolution, reject vulnerable versions with negative controls, and retain existing bounded parser/source map and build fixtures.
